description: Compute a holiday-aware week-over-week comparison of daily orders per store. For each non-holiday date D, the baseline is the same weekday one week earlier (D - 7); if D - 7 is a holiday in the store's country or has no data, fall back to D - 14; if that is also a holiday or missing, the baseline is NULL. wow_pct = 100 * (orders - baseline_orders) / baseline_orders. Holiday dates themselves are not reported. Output columns: store_id (INT64), metric_date (DATE), orders (INT64), baseline_date (DATE), baseline_orders (INT64), wow_pct (FLOAT64, 1 decimal). Report dates from 2025-06-23 onward, sorted by store_id, metric_date.

metric_date.description: Business date; closed days have no row

country.description: Country code used for the holiday calendar

edge_cases: 2025-06-17 is a holiday in the store's country, so 2025-06-24 falls back to 2025-06-10
A holiday in a different country (NO on 2025-06-24) must not affect a Swedish store
Baseline missing in both prior weeks yields NULL baseline and NULL wow_pct
Baseline of 0 orders must not raise a division error
common_failure_modes: FM2: LAG(orders, 7) counts rows, not calendar days, so with closed days it compares different weekdays
FM1: Joining holidays on date without country marks days as holidays for every store (and can duplicate rows when several countries share a date)
FM3: Comparing against the depressed holiday value (20) reports +350% growth
